device.description: 12-bit 1 MSPS SAR ADC with SPI-compatible serial output (VDD as reference)
device.note: adcs7476.pdf (SNAS192G) p.3 pin functions, p.4 recommended operating conditions, p.9-10 timing requirements, p.10-11 serial timing diagrams (Figures 2-4), p.16 serial interface, p.17 transfer function (straight binary), p.18 modes

pages: p.3 (pins: VDD1 GND2 VIN3 SCLK4 SDATA5 CS6), p.4 (ROC: VDD 2.7-5.25 V; digital inputs 2.7-5.25 V independent of supply), p.9-10 (t3 20 ns CS fall to SDATA out of TRI-STATE, t4 40 ns at 2.7-3.6 V, t8 25 ns), p.10-11 (Figure 2: four leading zeros, DB11-DB0), p.16 (frame: 16 SCLKs, bits out on SCLK falling edges, TRI-STATE after the 16th falling edge or CS rise), p.17 (straight binary)
notModeled: analog input (VDD is the reference); the conversion is clocked by SCLK (the result is the 0 V code at once)

SPI mode 3 (data out on SCLK falling edges, the receiver reads on the following edge); the datasheet allows SCLK idling either level: with a falling first edge the first leading zero may not be set up in time
SDATA TRI-STATE after the 16th falling SCLK edge (idle "z" after the 16 pattern bits) or at CS rise

shutdown mode: CS high before the 10th falling SCLK edge powers down until the next CS fall (no visible digital effect; the 1 us power-up / one dummy conversion is not modeled); such a frame aborts the conversion and truncates the word
tQUIET (50 ns) and SCLK frequency limits (10 kHz-20 MHz); t4 is 20 ns at VDD 4.75-5.25 V (the model uses 40 ns)
variants: ADCS7476 / ADCS7477 / ADCS7478 share the datasheet: 12 / 10 / 8 data bits in the same 16-SCLK frame (2 / 4 trailing zeros on the 10- / 8-bit parts), same SOT-23-6 pinout; own spec files
